name: Click Buffer
description: Buffers early jump inputs so they fire on the first legal frame.

buffer-frames.name: Buffer Frames
buffer-frames.description: How many frames before landing an early click is remembered (1-10).

buffer-rings.name: Buffer Rings
buffer-rings.description: Also fire buffered clicks when touching a ring/orb.

lookahead.name: Lookahead (experimental)
lookahead.description: Simulates ahead and waits to fire a buffered click on the frame that survives. May stutter or misbehave.

lookahead-steps.name: Lookahead Steps
lookahead-steps.description: How many physics steps to simulate ahead (more = safer but slower).

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: Run levels in test mode so no progress or stats are saved.
